one_line: Personified scholar-scribe embodying the Bakhshali birch-bark mathematics manuscript from ancient Gandhara.

appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown Gandharan complexion, straight nose, thoughtful dark eyes with slightly thick brows, a short well-groomed beard and moustache, default expression calm and focused with a hint of curious intensity
appearance.hair: dark brown hair, medium length, combed back and tied into a small low knot at the nape; front kept smooth with a simple narrow off-white cloth headband wrapped once around the forehead and knotted behind the ear
appearance.costume: era-accurate Gandharan scholar attire: a long-sleeved knee-length kurta-style tunic of soft undyed off-white cotton, worn under a cinnamon-brown woollen shawl draped from left shoulder across chest and around back in a continuous wrap, paired with loose straight trousers in muted olive green cotton gathered at the ankles, simple dark brown leather sandals, and minimal jewellery of one small copper bangle on the right wrist and a plain thread amulet at the neck; a rolled leather belt pouch at the left hip filled with stylus and pigment sticks; the overall look is modest, practical and travel-worn, with slight ink stains on cuffs.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved birch-bark folio held carefully in his left hand, edges darkened with age, its surface lightly marked with faded ink numerals and a distinctive small dot-shaped zero placeholder, while his right hand holds a slender reed stylus poised as if mid-calculation.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Gandharan scholar with medium-brown skin, dark hair in a low knot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white tunic, cinnamon-brown shawl, olive trousers and sandals, holding an aged birch-bark folio with dot zero and a reed stylus, in earthy tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a Gandharan male scholar in his mid-30s with an oval medium-brown face, short beard, thoughtful dark eyes, and dark brown hair combed back into a small low knot, circled by a simple narrow off-white headband. Show him standing in a neutral pose, front and three-quarter views, fully clothed in a knee-length long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic, a cinnamon-brown woollen shawl wrapped from left shoulder across his chest and around his back, loose olive green trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, and dark brown leather sandals. Add a copper bangle on his right wrist and a plain thread amulet at his neck, plus a small rolled belt pouch at his left hip with hints of tools inside. His cuffs should show slight ink stains to suggest constant writing. In his left hand, depict a gently curved, aged birch-bark folio with darker edges and faint ink numerals including a tiny dot-form zero placeholder; in his right hand, a slender reed stylus held as if ready to write. Use a palette of off-white, cinnamon brown, olive green, dark brown, and parchment beige, and keep the costume modest, historically grounded to ancient Gandhara, with clear, repeatable shapes and details from headband and hair knot to shawl drape, trousers, sandals, and the distinctive birch-bark manuscript folio and stylus.
